status.description: converged: the question is fully answered and no further turn is needed. needs_input: you need a decision or information from the caller before continuing. blocked: you cannot proceed (missing access, contradictory requirements, out of scope).

answer.description: The full answer for this turn, as prose or markdown. Do not compress it into bullet points for the sake of the schema; write what you would have written anyway.

open_questions.description: Specific questions the caller must answer for you to continue. Empty when status is converged.
